name: Rolly: Point of Sale & Store
dev: ROLL IT YOUR WAY PTY LTD

ios.desc:
App Store Description

Rolly is an ecommerce, POS, order, product, customer, and payment management app built for modern small businesses.

Create your online store, manage products, track orders, accept payments, handle customers, and run daily business operations from one simple platform.

Rolly helps business owners sell online and in person without switching between too many tools. Because apparently running a business was not already chaotic enough.

Whether you run a cafe, restaurant, retail store, florist, bakery, service business, or local shop, Rolly gives you the tools to manage your store from anywhere.

What You Can Do With Rolly

Create and manage your online store
Add products, categories, prices, images, and descriptions
Manage customer orders in one place
Track order status from pending to completed
Accept payments and manage payment records
View customer details and order history
Manage discounts, taxes, and surcharges
Track inventory and product availability
Use POS tools for in-store selling
Manage pickup, delivery, and shipping options
Review sales data and business performance
Update your store from your phone or computer

Built For Small Business

Rolly is designed for real businesses that need simple tools, fast setup, and clear control.

You can manage your products, orders, customers, payments, and storefront without needing a developer, plugin stack, or a spreadsheet monster hiding in the corner.

Rolly is suitable for:

Online stores
Retail shops
Cafes and restaurants
Florists
Bakeries
Fashion stores
Local service businesses
Pop-up stores
Market sellers
Small business owners

Sell Online And In Person

Rolly helps you manage both ecommerce and in-store sales.

Create your online store, sell through your website, manage incoming orders, and use POS tools when customers buy in person. Your products, customers, and orders stay connected in one system.

Manage Orders Faster

Keep every order organised.

View order details, customer information, payment status, delivery method, pickup details, discounts, taxes, and notes in one place.

Product And Inventory Management

Add products with images, prices, descriptions, categories, SKUs, variants, options, and add-ons.

Track availability and keep your store updated without digging through ten tabs like some kind of digital archaeologist.

Customer Management

Store customer details, contact information, order history, and notes. Rolly helps you understand who buys from you and how often

android.desc:
You did not start your business to stare at screens.

You started it to share your food, your craft, and your passion with the world. But somewhere along the way, running a business became about managing chaos. You are juggling online orders, a physical storefront, tangled receipt printers, endless spreadsheets, and late-night inventory panics.

It is exhausting. Rolly is here to give you your time back.

Most Point of Sale systems force your business to adapt to their software. We think that is backwards. Rolly is a complete, all-in-one commerce platform designed to bend entirely around you. Whether you are running a quiet retail boutique, a bustling restaurant, or a growing global online store, Rolly is the silent partner that handles the heavy lifting so you can get back to what matters.

Build the system that fits your rhythm:

A POS That Adapts to You
Every business is different. That is why Rolly lets you completely customize your Point of Sale interface and workflows. Build the POS that fits your exact needs, so your staff can process orders quickly and naturally.

Grow Without the Growing Pains
Start with what you need, and expand when you are ready. Rolly offers powerful module extensions. Add new capabilities as your business scales, ensuring you always have the right tools without the clutter.

Effortless Online Selling
Build and run your online store easily. No coding, no developers, no tech headaches. Manage your physical products, online orders, and payments from one single, unified platform.

Bring Calm to Your Restaurant
Hospitality is fast-paced. Rolly helps you manage the floor with intuitive Table Management and reservation tracking. Stop worrying about the math—Rolly automatically calculates complex service charges and taxes the second it is time to pay.

Hardware That Just Works
Connect your thermal and receipt printers seamlessly. No driver errors, no frustration. Support multiple screens and customer-facing displays to build trust and transparency at the checkout counter.

Your Data, Instantly
Moving systems shouldn't take weeks. Upload your entire inventory and export your data instantly with seamless Excel spreadsheet integration and Bulk Import tools. Thousands of products, loaded in seconds.

quotes.text:
You know that feeling when you’ve been working on something for what feels like forever, and it finally comes to life? That’s exactly how we feel right now.

After months (okay, maybe years) of planning, building, and countless late nights, we finally launched Rolly – our own ecommerce builder.

We built Rolly with one simple idea: small businesses deserve better.
No more wrestling with complicated platforms, hidden fees, or confusing setups. We wanted to make it easy, smooth, and actually enjoyable to set up your online store.

With Rolly, you can go from idea to live storefront in minutes. Drag, drop, and sell. It’s really that simple. We packed it with all the tools you need to grow—inventory management, payment processing, custom domains, and more—without the headaches.

This isn’t just another platform. This is the platform we wish we had when we started.

We’re just getting started, and we’re excited to help more small businesses shine online.

If you want to check it out, head over to Rolly and see what we’ve been building.

Link to check it out https://rolly.app

Link to the appstore https://apps.apple.com/gd/app/rolly-small-business-tools/id6479781630?platform=iphone

Link to playstore https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.arcanetify.justinvoice

Ben from Rolly
quotes.story_title: We created our online ecommerce builder called Rolly
